blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has flagged a P271.47-million discrepancy between the approved budget and the winning bidder’s price for a learning management system under Cebu Normal University’s (CNU) P947.83-million Centralized Student Smart Hub project. State auditors cited procurement deficiencies that raised questions about the justification of component prices, the completeness […]...
